label: Долгий / Краткий
description: Долгий vs краткий: long (in time)/brief contrasts across genders and everyday scenes.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Masculine nominative agreement and temporal sense. 'Долгий' takes the masculine ending to match 'путь' and means long in time, not in distance. The travel phrase fixes the duration meaning.

Strategic focus: Feminine nominative agreement. 'Краткая' takes the feminine ending to match 'встреча' and signals a brief, short-lived event. The sentence anchors the temporal sense in a everyday encounter.
Strategic focus: Neuter nominative agreement. 'Долгое' takes the neuter ending to match 'лето' and describes a stretch of time. The seasonal image makes the neuter form concrete.
Strategic focus: Plural nominative agreement. 'Долгие' takes the plural ending to match 'вечера' and points to drawn-out time. The cosy scene fixes the plural temporal form.

missions.phrase: После долгой дороги был краткий отдых.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Direct temporal contrast. 'Долгой' is feminine genitive after 'после' for 'дороги', while 'краткий' is masculine nominative for 'отдых'. The sentence pairs a lengthy journey against a brief rest.
Strategic focus: Masculine accusative agreement. 'Краткий' matches the inanimate masculine 'миг', whose accusative equals the nominative. The phrase pins down the sense of a fleeting moment.

Strategic focus: Feminine instrumental in the predicate. After past-tense 'была', 'краткой' takes the feminine instrumental ending to match 'лекция'. This shows the быть-plus-instrumental pattern with a temporal meaning.
Strategic focus: Plural instrumental in the predicate. After 'были', 'долгими' takes the plural instrumental ending to match 'разговоры'. The sentence extends the duration sense into the plural.
Strategic focus: Short-form masculine predicate. The short form 'краток' states a present quality of 'ответ' with a vowel-fill 'о'. Short forms suit a clipped description of brevity.
Strategic focus: Comparative form. 'Дольше' is the comparative of 'долгий' for duration and stays the same for any gender. The sentence compares this trip's length in time to the usual.
